scope: Current repository research and feature catalogue; one dossier per idea. Idea counts are not independent experiment counts.

status_labels.implemented: Validated within its stated contract and available in the current code
status_labels.validated-not-integrated: Validated capability, diagnostic or research method; not deployed as a production optimization
status_labels.tested-not-selected: Tested candidate failed a gate, did not improve performance, or was not selected; reason is specific to the tested contract
status_labels.untested-or-hardware-unavailable: Proposed, incomplete, source-only or unavailable on the target hardware; not a negative benchmark

ideas.title: A100 feasibility: TMA, clusters, FP8, DPX and virtual grouping
ideas.summary: Missing hardware capabilities cannot be enabled by a compiler flag; software substitutes remain distinct proposals.

ideas.title: Four-edge A100 tensor dependency scheduler
ideas.summary: Experiment-only graph scheduler separates accumulator latency, independent HMMA issue spacing, operand readiness and observer dependencies; A100 hardware validation remains open.

ideas.title: Adam epsilon sensitivity of near-invariant BF16 key bias
ideas.summary: Changing epsilon explains sensitivity under a different training policy; it is not a repair of the original gate.

ideas.title: Adaptive shared-memory budgeting
ideas.summary: The production native GEMM has an explicit fixed contract: two 32 KiB shared operand regions, 64 KiB dynamic shared memory and 128 threads.

ideas.title: Cross-architecture encoding and cubin observations
ideas.summary: Historical CUDA 12.8 probes examined common control fields on SM75/86/90/100/120 and parameter/ELF metadata changes.

ideas.title: Recovered arithmetic instruction sequences and rounding policy
ideas.summary: The standard backend imports retained CUDA 12.8 arithmetic fragments and generates its own words.

ideas.title: Asymmetric shared-memory address layouts
ideas.summary: The historical shared-layout sweep tested asymmetric 7/3 and 3/7 swizzles against symmetric 7/7.

ideas.title: Automatic equivalent SASS sequence search
ideas.summary: Historical candidate searches explored several epilogue orders, fragment windows, pre-addressing, operand orders and scheduler variants; selected changes contributed to the current GEMM.

ideas.title: Preserving intermediate casts as a BF16 repair attempt
ideas.summary: Keeping eager-like casts still fails the original BF16 parameter gate; the setting was not promoted.

ideas.title: Compile-time rank-seven versus rank-eight native MMA
ideas.summary: Compile-time rank-seven tests did not establish a competitive precision-matched end-to-end tensor mainloop.

ideas.title: Python versus a compiled host implementation
ideas.summary: No profile shows that rewriting the host compiler improves GPU instruction speed; profile individual host passes first.

ideas.title: Constant integer division and remainder lowering
ideas.summary: The implemented 32-bit lowering removes a reciprocal-based path from direct PTX division/remainder sites.

ideas.title: Control-flow recovery and a SASS-to-PTX lifter
ideas.summary: Useful instruction and reconvergence patterns were observed; a complete structured lifter is not shipped.

ideas.title: Cooperative population LayerNorm
ideas.summary: Shifted population LayerNorm passes full finite-domain tests; affine, saved statistics and backward are absent.

ideas.title: Cooperative FP32 row softmax
ideas.summary: Native warp-per-row softmax passes the full five-pattern contract; large serial-mapping gains, ptxas still faster.

ideas.title: Loadable cubins and metadata-safe code replacement
ideas.summary: The production container code parses/serializes CUDA ELF and .nv.info records, replaces kernel text, fixes exit offsets and declares the generated register count.

ideas.title: cuBLAS dispatch observation and cuBLASLt controls
ideas.summary: Vendor dispatch and matched controls guide independent kernels; no vendor kernel was extracted into the compiler.

ideas.title: CUDA C/C++ frontend through nvcc PTX
ideas.summary: nvcc supplies CUDA parsing/PTX, while OpenAssembler supplies supported native SASS generation.

ideas.title: CUDA-L2 project source audit
ideas.summary: Pinned public source and contracts were inspected; a faithful port and performance reproduction remain open.

ideas.title: Public CUTLASS and cuBLASLt techniques for A100
ideas.summary: Public CUTLASS pipelines and cuBLASLt dispatch controls identify transferable tiling, staging, epilogue, traversal and heuristic designs; proprietary cuBLAS kernels are not extracted.

ideas.title: CUTLASS-style load-next / compute-current fragment schedule
ideas.summary: Source-inclusive A100 checks pass on six FP16 shapes; the candidate wins five non-square cases but regresses 4096^3 and raises register pressure.

ideas.title: Dead-code removal, copy coalescing and local folding
ideas.summary: These passes are in the regular scalar and tensor compilation pipelines before allocation.

ideas.title: Deeper copy pipelines and larger tiles
ideas.summary: For the tested 64-wide K tile, two stages beat three/four: approximately 1.003 ms versus 1.178/1.180 ms in the archived run.

ideas.title: Direct pointer homes for asynchronous GEMM copies
ideas.summary: Explicit mode improves tested MLP products but regresses on tall GEMM; legacy remains the default.

ideas.title: Earlier pointer advancement in tensor mainloops
ideas.summary: Integrated as explicit early/late/shape-specific auto policy; early helps the measured wide shape and regresses tall controls, so auto remains narrow.

ideas.title: Fused Adam-like scalar update example
ideas.summary: Fused example passes tolerance and beats the chosen eager expression; it is not complete AdamW or a tuned-optimizer comparison.

ideas.title: Fused local dot products for backward row reductions
ideas.summary: Explicit FMA improves selected native backward reductions; smaller cases can lose and same-source ptxas remains faster.

ideas.title: Fused FP32 bias, residual and ReLU epilogues
ideas.summary: The explicit `bias_residual` and `bias_residual_relu` plans compute `(A@B.T + Bias) + Residual`, then optional finite-value ReLU, with FP32 inputs to the epilogue and FP32 output.

ideas.title: GPU execution, explicit launch specifications and fault isolation
ideas.summary: Typed launch planning, fault-isolated local/Modal/SSH transports implemented; Modal hardware is validated and latest real SSH evidence is absent.

ideas.title: CUTLASS-style grouped-N CTA traversal
ideas.summary: A grouped-N launch mapping passes full gates and wins the tall FP16 shape, while wide and square cases do not justify universal dispatch.

ideas.title: Hilbert, grouped-M and alternative CTA orders
ideas.summary: The phase-five study tested N-fast, grouped-M, Morton8 and Hilbert8 while retaining the physical HMMA/LDSM/LDGSTS words and controls.

ideas.title: Immutable inference weight-packing cache
ideas.summary: Versioned eager packing and immutable captured inference pass 26 method/network pairs; equally cached ptxas remains faster.

ideas.title: Joint shared-layout and register-fragment search
ideas.summary: Existing swizzle experiments largely held register organization fixed; fragment-window and tile experiments explored other dimensions separately.

ideas.title: Joint direct-pointer, traversal and epilogue options
ideas.summary: Joint combinations pass full correctness; direct-plus-fusion has narrow gains while direct-plus-Morton is mostly neutral or worse.

ideas.title: Persisting-L2 cache allocation policies
ideas.summary: The controlled cache-policy study performed 224 output checks across square/tall FP16/BF16 and policy settings, with graph-node policy readback.

ideas.title: Four-way counted-loop unrolling
ideas.summary: The `opt` scalar path applies four-way unrolling to the supported counted-loop form.

ideas.title: Exact AlphaTensor/Strassen factors and FP32 research plans
ideas.summary: Exact factors and explicit FP32 research plans exist; sampled/interrupted timing records do not prove a general win.

ideas.title: Fuse low-rank transforms into operand staging
ideas.summary: The existing runtime-factor and tiny compile-time studies identify this as promising future work.

ideas.title: Two-slot asynchronous barrier overlap
ideas.summary: A two-slot one-CTA overlap probe works; dense-GEMM integration and an application benefit remain unproven.

ideas.title: Morton8 logical CTA traversal
ideas.summary: Corrected 8×8 tile traversal helps tested tall grids; it is not an MMA storage layout or automatic policy.

ideas.title: Alternative multi-precision accumulation paths
ideas.summary: The implemented tensor GEMM already uses mixed precision in the ordinary sense: FP16/BF16 inputs with FP32 accumulation and FP32 output.

ideas.title: Native tanh-approximation GELU example
ideas.summary: Tanh-GELU passes a predeclared FP64 tolerance, while the old exact gate failure remains and gains depend on size.

ideas.title: Native GEMMs inside a complete hybrid residual MLP
ideas.summary: Complete hybrid steps are checked, including packing and optimizer work; effects are mixed and integration is experimental.

ideas.title: Native scalar ReLU example
ideas.summary: Finite-input exact example passes; measured large-size PyTorch is faster, with no universal speedup.

ideas.title: Native SM80 tensor GEMM compiler and mainloop
ideas.summary: The production `gemm` path computes C=A@B.T with contiguous FP16/BF16 operands, FP32 accumulation/output, 128×128×64 CTA tiles, four 64×64 warp tiles, 128 threads and 64 KiB dynamic shared memory.

ideas.title: Native NN arithmetic and composed-network campaign
ideas.summary: 26 operator families and six custom NN configurations expose conditional gains and failed training gates; no general CUDA superiority.

ideas.title: No-op address instruction removal
ideas.summary: Removing eight proven no-op address adds passed full output checks and reduced static SASS, but did not improve paired A100 timing.

ideas.title: Operand reuse hints and ordering
ideas.summary: The tensor scheduler emits reuse hints for supported neighboring HMMA operands.

ideas.title: Padded forward/backward integration prototype
ideas.summary: The phase-two FP16/BF16 hook passed forward/backward and three-step state checks under its explicit padding/rounding policy.

ideas.title: Paired B-fragment LDSM loads and register-group use
ideas.summary: The selected native kernel uses paired `LDSM.x4` B loads.

ideas.title: Post-allocation pointer-copy forwarding
ideas.summary: The tested rewrite is correct but produces exactly the direct-pointer stream; it adds no distinct optimization.

ideas.title: Copy prefetch hints and bounded fragment windows
ideas.summary: The production follow-up tested cp.async L2-prefetch modifiers, B-fragment windows of two/four and bounded prefetch.

ideas.title: Software producer/consumer warp specialization
ideas.summary: The tested role-split variants passed four large-case A100 correctness checks but measured about 1.019–1.943 ms and lost to the unified-warp schedule.

ideas.title: Native PTX input and compilation boundary
ideas.summary: Supported SM80 PTX routes to the native scalar/tensor backends with explicit verification limits.

ideas.title: Typed Python kernel frontend
ideas.summary: Typed numeric Python source compiles without executing imports; fixed GPU numeric semantics are explicit.

ideas.title: PyTorch application capture and saved replay
ideas.summary: Actual verified capture/replay passes77 tensors and cache-only replay; lowering is Inductor/Triton, not native OA.

ideas.title: Repository discovery, manifests and safe artifact publication
ideas.summary: Safe discovery, path mirroring, manifests, locking and publication are implemented and tested.

ideas.title: Runtime-factor Triton low-rank lowering
ideas.summary: The early A10040GB prototype was far slower: at 4096³ FP16, cuBLAS was about 0.511 ms, direct Triton 1.325 ms, Strassen 11.611 ms and AlphaTensor 13.041 ms.

ideas.title: SASS execution emulator and fitted tensor arithmetic
ideas.summary: Functional execution and fitted tensor arithmetic pass the recorded cases; they do not prove real timing or all special values.

ideas.title: SM80 SASS instruction encoding
ideas.summary: The production encoder emits the supported SM80 instructions from generated templates and field maps.

ideas.title: Naive scalar attention-score baseline
ideas.summary: The illustrative score kernel fails its retained exact gate; it is not a fused attention implementation.

ideas.title: Serial scalar cross-entropy baseline
ideas.summary: The example exists, but its retained exact hardware gate fails; no speedup is admitted.

ideas.title: Scalar register dependencies, scoreboards and synchronized shuffles
ideas.summary: Fresh binding, reader sets, scoreboard-generation retirement, source WAR and actual WARPSYNC repair hardware failures.

ideas.title: Naive scalar matrix-multiplication baseline
ideas.summary: The scalar example fails its retained exact gate and is not the validated tensor-core GEMM.

ideas.title: Register allocation, aligned groups and guarded definitions
ideas.summary: The scalar compiler uses virtual values, liveness, stable homes for repeated/guarded definitions and aligned register-group allocation.

ideas.title: Measured scalar instruction scheduling
ideas.summary: Corrected fixed-pipe probes found four cycles for tested same-pipe ALU/FMA pairs, five across tested classes, and 13 from a predicate definition to tested guarded instructions/branches.

ideas.title: Shared-memory swizzling and bank conflicts
ideas.summary: The selected GEMM uses the tested symmetric 7/7 XOR swizzle.

ideas.title: Software fragment caching in registers
ideas.summary: Bounded B-fragment windows of two/four and prefetch variants passed correctness but were slower across seven paired rounds on the tested workloads.

ideas.title: Structured-sparse MMA capability probes
ideas.summary: Limited ptxas-built sparse probes ran on A100; native OA sparse code generation and speedup are not established.

ideas.title: Stable analytic GELU backward
ideas.summary: A stable exponential derivative passes the unchanged accuracy gate after the direct-tanh form fails; no ptxas speed win.

ideas.title: Two-tile stage-pair specialization and peeled drain
ideas.summary: `--schedule stagepair` is the selected production plan.

ideas.title: Complete application-state verification diagnostics
ideas.summary: Checks all state groups under unchanged gates and bounded failure reports; exposes both BF16 parameter failures.

ideas.title: Carry-linked pointer updates and folded shared addresses
ideas.summary: The earlier address work reduced one selected kernel from 1,898 to 1,812 static non-NOP instructions; six same-worker cases improved about 0.9–5.4%.

ideas.title: Hardware-counter-guided tensor analysis
ideas.summary: Retained matched profiles show equal tensor work but different overhead and stalls.

ideas.title: Clocked tensor probes and synchronization sweeps
ideas.summary: Corrected exact-SASS probes measured an approximately eight-cycle-per-operation slope for the tested dependent HMMA sequence and about 41 cycles per iteration for LDSM→LOP3→IADD3.

ideas.title: Vectorized FP32 result stores
ideas.summary: The native GEMM epilogue groups FP32 stores into pairs and passes an existing aligned register pair directly when possible.

ideas.title: Whole-transformer training and inference evaluation
ideas.summary: Nine of ten configurations pass both rounds; gains use Inductor/Triton and BF16 training remains excluded.
